docs.quoted: A quoted string whose body is any codepoints except quote/backslash.

source:
## Semantics: U1 (rs#297) — the quoted-string idiom over multibyte text:
## the negated-class run advances by whole codepoints.
grammar ConformanceUnicodeQuoted version "1.0.0" mode "classic" {
  ## A quoted string whose body is any codepoints except quote/backslash.
  quoted = "\"" *( !("\"" / "\\") ANY ) "\""

  entry main: quoted

  test main {
    accept "\"日本語 中文\""
    accept "\"emoji 🎉🚀 here\""
    accept "\"ascii too\""
    reject "\"unterminated"
    reject "\"mixed ☃\" trailing"
  }
}
